strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ You WILL be signed out of Google accounts (you must re-add them).
• Your photos and apps are untouched.
• The device reboots automatically after.

Are you sure?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: checks the current keybox against Google's revocation list (CRL) and tries multiple sources until it finds a valid keybox, with an automatic backup and a restart of Google services. Runs on every tap and needs internet (1-3 minutes).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: downloads a keybox from the official repository (GitHub) and saves it to /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Needs internet and takes 1-3 minutes. Used when the smart fetch fails or when the keybox was changed manually.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: checks the available Remote Key Provisioning modules, inspects the TEE attestation certificate version, and shows the KmInstallKeybox tool state. Changes nothing — a plain device status view.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): shows Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) from dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, and related system properties. Modifies nothing at all.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues when the automatic pass fails. Every run prints a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: clears Play Store and Google services (GMS+GSF) data and reboots the device automatically. For stubborn attestation only — it never touches your photos or files.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: checks the RKP certificate attestation state of the device and resets the attestation properties if needed. Does not touch user data.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fixes Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. Used for some devices that rely on SOTER instead of Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: shows the installed engine state, the fingerprint files (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), and the logs. Check only — it modifies nothing.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fetches the latest Canary Engine release to ensure compatibility with the mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.btnKbSlotsPromote: Guteza imbere icyiciro cya kabiri → primaire
strings.hintKbSlots: Module icunga ibice bibiri byingenzi: ibanze (byera, ntabwo byigeze bihanagurwa) hamwe na kabiri (backup). Iyi tab irerekana ikibanza gikora, gihindura ibyifuzo, cyangwa gitezimbere icyiciro cya kabiri kubanze kubisabwa bisobanutse - hamwe na backup hamwe na logi yuzuye.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: checks the TEE key import, the library injection inside keystore2, the revocation status (CRL), the protection-list coverage and the RKP state. Read-only — it changes nothing.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
• Google Play services are restarted.

Nothing is deleted and the primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: shows the state of the primary and secondary slots and switches the preference between them. The primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) is always protected and never wiped. Promoting the secondary to primary requires explicit confirmation.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promote the secondary slot to primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml becomes the primary slot content.
• The current primary is saved as a backup before replacement.
• Nothing is deleted — the operation is reversible.

Continue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Clear the secondary slot:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml will be removed.
• The primary slot is not touched.

Continue?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (new in v3.17):

• Checks the current keybox against the Google revocation list (CRL).
• Tries multiple sources until a clean keybox is found.
• Automatic backup + restarts Google services.

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Continue?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Fetch keybox from the internet:

• Downloads the official keybox and validates it.
• Installed permanently (never reverted at boot).

⚠️ Needs internet (up to 1 min). Continue?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• No data or keybox files are deleted.
• Reboot the phone afterwards.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Full repair:

• Re-provisions RKP + restarts Google services.
• The device reboots automatically (nothing is wiped).

Continue?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Restart Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — restart only.
• Nothing is wiped and you will NOT be signed out.
• The device reboots automatically.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• For devices that ignore the leaked keybox.
• Works even if the keys are healthy.
• No data is deleted.

Continue?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store certification:

• Clears only the Store cache — your account is untouched.
• Reboot, then open the Store.

Continue?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• Restarts the vendor.soter service.
• Clears the SOTER server data only.

Continue?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Apply fingerprint (PIF):

• Converts custom.pif.prop and installs it into the engine path.
• Requires a reboot afterwards.

Continue?
strings.confirmCanary:
Update Canary fingerprint:

• Downloads the latest official Canary fingerprint from Google.
• Syncs the security patch + restarts Google services (no wipe).

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Continue?
